statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 17 (low), Stress 50 (elevated), Confidence 86 (high). One narrow window is flagged around the quarterly expiration close.
recommendation: Conditions remain consistent with the mapped EA_ON state for NQ futures and NAS100 CFD. A narrow flagged window covers 19:00-20:15 UTC, where the mapped forecast state moves to WATCH around the quadruple-witching close auction. Standing existing-position management and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Nasdaq-100 holds a narrow two-way band into the quarterly expiration close
body: NDX trades at 29,461 (+0.05%) inside a 0.64% session band of 29,372-29,560 after opening at 29,529 and reverting to mid-range, so retracements are completing rather than failing. VIX is 15.43 with a 14.99-15.63 range and shows no bid for protection. The macro backdrop is demanding: the Federal Reserve raised rates on 16 September and signalled further tightening, the 10-year Treasury yield sits near 5.01% against a 2-year at 4.74%, and crude remains above $100 with Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline still impaired after the 10-11 September drone strikes. That combination is scored as elevated Stress rather than Tail, consistent with the rule that event importance and cross-asset tension raise drawdown risk before they establish a no-retracement path. Today is the September quadruple-witching expiration, the heaviest flow session of the quarter, which concentrates unwind and rebalance order flow into the 20:00Z cash close; the flagged window covers that auction and its immediate aftermath. CME equity-index futures then close for the week at 21:00Z, so twenty of the twenty-four forecast hours carry no tradable price path and Tail falls to a residual weekend floor while gap exposure accrues toward the Sunday 22:00Z reopen.

lookbackSummary: The Thursday afternoon that followed the 16 September Fed hike carried a trend-up mode and Tail of 20-22, mapping to WATCH through 21:00Z. Tail decayed to 17-18 overnight as the mode normalised, then held between 15 and 19 across the Asian and European sessions with the mapped state at EA_ON. The mode shifted from trend-up to mixed at 11:00Z as the US morning turned two-way, while Stress climbed from the low 40s to around 50 on the combination of crude above $100 and the 10-year yield pressing 5%. All 24 lookback hours are covered by published assessments.
outlookSummary: The remaining US afternoon is expected to stay range-bound under expiration pinning, with the narrow flagged window at 19:00-20:15 UTC covering the quadruple-witching close auction and its unwind, where forecast Tail peaks at 21 and the mapped state is WATCH. CME equity-index futures then close for the week at 21:00Z, so the final twenty hours of the window carry no tradable price path; forecast Tail settles at a residual 10-13 and drifts up slowly as unpriced weekend headline exposure accumulates toward the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, which falls outside this window. Confidence decays from 86 to 73 across the halt because no fresh price-path evidence can arrive. The unresolved Saudi East-West pipeline outage and the signalled further Fed tightening are the stored conditionals for Monday.
